null_study.what: curve_spread minus raw close-difference, over every liquid 5-wide adjacent put pair on every day of every fetched chain. No gate applied.

selection_bias.what: the null statistic evaluated on the GATE-SELECTED entries. Negative = the booked credit is HIGHER than a same-day cross-leg-consistent estimate, i.e. the floor selected days whose raw print pair happened to be wide.

exit_trigger_audit.what: for every booked exit, the raw close-difference mark that triggered it vs the same-day cross-leg-consistent spread.

survivorship.what: realized vol of the entries EXCLUDED from the availability denominator vs those kept. If dropping is vol-correlated, the surviving sample is not a random subsample and the availability rate is biased.
survivorship.interpretation: |t| > 2 means the drop is vol-correlated; dropped days being LOWER vol biases availability UP, because low-IV days are the days a credit floor is hardest to clear.

band_bracket_audit.what: every band-related rejection with the fetched grid's |delta| range. brackets_delta_band=False means the strikes that would have answered the question were never fetched.

blocking.why_it_matters: entry-week blocks cannot contain a holding period longer than a week, so simultaneously-open trades are resampled as independent draws and the LB95 is too tight.

walk_coverage.what: trading days inside a held window where at least one leg has no bar, so the day was never marked.

friction.note: execution_costs.friction_r proxies each leg's mark by net_credit (leg-mid-sum = 2 x net_credit), exact only at wing ratio 1/3. Compare wing_ratio_long_over_short against 1/3: the deployed model's spread leg is off by exactly leg_mid_sum_over_net_credit / 2 (>1 = understated).

iv_by_month.what: UNCONDITIONAL IV is measured over every in-band liquid strike on every planned entry day. The CONDITIONAL figures are the qualified trades only and are selected on credit, hence on IV — they cannot be read as the month's vol level.
iv_by_month.liquidity_lag_note: this section deliberately uses the same-day count so the IV census covers the widest strike set; it is a description of the data, not a tradeable screen.

width_census.what: credit/width of every constructible vertical on an in-band liquid short candidate, per width, with no credit floor applied.
width_census.interpretation: if the spec floor sits ABOVE the median credit/width, low availability is a gate-design consequence, not a data artifact — and widening cannot help when the wider width's median is lower.

payoff_attribution.tail_note: the -1R tail is UNSAMPLED, not absent: a full -1R needs the short strike still breached at the forced 21-DTE exit, which never happened in this window. Its absence is a property of the window, not of the strategy.
payoff_attribution.attribution_warning: deleting a month is not a neutral operation — check unconditional_median_iv on the month being deleted before reading any 'excluding X' figure as the strategy's expectancy.
